title: Hotspots Summary
description: Top-5 function summary derived from a `hotspots analyze --mode snapshot` run (hotspots 3.0 and later; earlier runs also passed `--explain-patterns`, which 3.0 removed). This is a derived artifact, not the raw CLI output -- served at each post's report_json URL on reports.hotspots.dev. Keep this file in sync with the summary builder whenever it changes; it was found drifted (lrs/quadrant/touches_30d/days_since_changed documented but never emitted, risk_tier emitted but undocumented, quadrant enum using stale values) and corrected 2026-10-10.

sha.description: Full 40-character git commit SHA that was analyzed

analyzed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the analysis ran

hotspots_version.description: Version of the hotspots CLI that produced this snapshot

clone_depth.description: Git clone depth used — affects how far back commit history is considered when computing activity scores. Null if not recorded for this run.

hybrid_touch_threshold.description: Present only on runs from before hotspots 3.0, which removed hybrid touch mode (touch data is now file-level). Absent or null otherwise.

by_tier.description: Function count per activity tier (hotspots 3.0 and later). 'active' means the function's file was touched more often than the repo median or changed in the last 30 days; 'quiet' is everything else. Absent on runs from before 3.0.

total_functions.description: Total functions analyzed in this snapshot

by_band.description: Function count per risk band (e.g. critical/high/moderate/low)

top_risk.description: Activity-weighted risk score of the highest-ranked function in this snapshot

top.description: Top functions ranked by activity-weighted risk, descending. Typically 5 entries.

function.description: Function name. '<anonymous>' for arrow functions or unnamed expressions.

file.description: File path relative to the repo root

risk.description: Activity-weighted risk score for this function: structural complexity plus how much and how recently its file has changed, each on a fixed scale.

risk_tier.description: Risk band label for this function (e.g. critical/high/moderate/low).

patterns.description: Antipattern labels detected on this function. Always empty for runs from hotspots 3.0 and later, which no longer detect patterns; present on older runs.

pattern_counts.description: Aggregate count of each antipattern label across all top functions. Empty object for runs from hotspots 3.0 and later.

top_patterns.description: Antipattern labels sorted by frequency (most common first). Empty for runs from hotspots 3.0 and later.
